name: leap-by-enerdatics
description: Enerdatics renewable-energy M&A, financing, project, PPA and PPA price data for ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Leap brings Enerdatics' energy-transition market intelligence into ChatGPT. Ask in plain language and ChatGPT answers from Enerdatics' sourced records of renewable and clean-energy M&A deals, project financings, power projects, power purchase agreements (PPAs), investment opportunities, data centers, US distributed generation and US PPA price data reported to FERC, plus Enerdatics research reports.

Who it is for: M&A teams and advisors who screen targets, find comparable transactions and benchmark valuation multiples ($/MW, EV/EBITDA); developers and investors who size markets, rank the most active buyers, sellers, lenders and advisors, and profile a company's portfolio and deal history; and suppliers and service providers who track the project, financing and PPA pipeline.

Results can open as interactive views inside ChatGPT: sortable, filterable tables, valuation benchmark charts, league tables, PPA price charts, company profiles and a page-by-page report reader. Records carry a link to the record on the Enerdatics platform.

Limitations: Leap reads data only, apart from an optional tool that sends your feedback to the Enerdatics team. US PPA price data and distributed-generation data cover the United States only. Figures reflect what Enerdatics has recorded; undisclosed deal values are shown as not disclosed rather than estimated.

Access: Leap requires an Enerdatics account. Users sign in with their Enerdatics account and see only the data their organisation has access to.
capabilities: Search renewable and clean-energy M&A deals by country, sector, technology, size and date
Benchmark valuation multiples such as $/MW and EV/EBITDA, split by asset stage
Rank buyers, sellers, owners, developers, offtakers, lenders and advisors in league tables
Profile a company's portfolio, deal history, financings and PPAs
Search power projects by market, technology, capacity and lifecycle stage
Search PPAs and chart US PPA prices reported to FERC
Search project financings, investment opportunities and data centers
Search US distributed-generation projects (rooftop and community solar, storage)
Search and read Enerdatics research reports page by page
Export result sets to CSV, Excel, JSON or Markdown
defaultPrompt: Show me valuation multiples for solar assets in Spain since 2024, by asset stage.
Show me a league table of who owns the most battery storage capacity in ERCOT.
Chart realized solar PPA prices in PJM over time.

positive.description: Valuation multiples by asset stage (valuation view)
positive.prompt: Show me valuation multiples for solar assets in Spain since 2024, by asset stage.
positive.expected_behavior: An interactive valuation view renders: a KPI row with the median $/MW and the number of priced deals, a chart, and the priced-deal table. Operating and under-development assets are shown separately. Deals without a disclosed value are excluded, not estimated.

positive.prompt: Show me a league table of who owns the most battery storage capacity in ERCOT.
positive.expected_behavior: A ranked bar chart of battery storage owners in ERCOT by MW renders, with the underlying project records in a sortable, filterable table. render_league alone is enough; get_league_table may also run.

positive.prompt: Give me a company profile of Orsted.
positive.expected_behavior: A company profile view renders with the portfolio by technology and geography, M&A deals, financings, PPAs and key financial figures.

positive.prompt: Chart solar PPA prices in PJM since 2023, split by offtaker type.
positive.expected_behavior: A US PPA price chart in $/MWh by quarter renders, one line per offtaker type, with the priced contract rows underneath. render_ferc_pricing alone is enough; search_ferc_pricing may also run.

positive.description: Project screen in a table (table view)
positive.prompt: Show me a table of utility-scale battery projects in ERCOT that are in construction.
positive.expected_behavior: A sortable, filterable table of battery projects in ERCOT at the In construction stage renders (up to 50 rows), with the total number of matches in the caption and a link per row. render_exhibit alone is enough; aggregate or search_projects may also run.

negative.description: Investment advice on a listed stock is out of scope: Leap holds private-market energy transaction data, not stock prices, price targets or recommendations. Expected: no Leap tool is called; ChatGPT answers without Leap data.
negative.prompt: Should I buy NextEra Energy stock right now, and what's your price target?

negative.description: General contract-practice question: Leap holds deal records, not legal guidance. Expected: answered from general knowledge without calling Leap and without citing a Leap record.
negative.prompt: In a US solar PPA, is it typically a condition precedent that the seller needs to close financing by a certain time? When?

negative.description: European PPA price benchmarks do not exist in Leap (its PPA price data is US only). Expected: the answer says Leap has no European PPA prices and invents none; if Leap is checked, no US figures are substituted.
negative.prompt: What are PPA price benchmarks for each generation type in the 5 largest markets in Europe?

review.commerce_description: Leap does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Leap by Enerdatics for ChatGPT: search and analysis over Enerdatics renewable-energy M&A deals, financings, projects, PPAs, opportunities, data centers, US distributed generation, US FERC PPA price data and research reports, with interactive views for tables, valuation multiples, league tables, PPA prices, company profiles and reports.
